html:
The Dark Order's Ceremonial
Class:  Mage
Damage:  varies with item level

The Dark Order's Ceremonial is a mage rainbow item.

This item is soulbound. 1st Edition Item Pack Exclusive. The pieces sit on Karl's holiday Well table when that look is on. The list is on Holiday Rainbows.

Attributes:

No fixed bonuses are known beyond the rainbow name itself.

Rolled copies can also pick up an extra ending. Those endings and their bonuses are listed on Mythic Suffixes.
